entities.summary: Sonoko Inoue (b. 1997-12-11, Kobe) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kobe and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
